headline: Bitcoin Slides as Democratic Sweep Bets Threaten Crypto Agenda
summary: Bitcoin slid as much as 2.8% to $75,630.57 in Asia trading as political bets regarding a Democratic sweep threatened the crypto legislative agenda.
why: Cryptocurrency valuations often react to shifts in political expectations regarding future regulatory and legislative policies.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Political shifts perceived as adverse to the crypto industry decrease demand and push the asset price lower.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Shifting political expectations concerning future regulatory policies created headwinds for digital assets, driving down Bitcoin prices.
